audit: DataForge V3.1 — Phase 1A Baseline Reliability Audit

upstream.working_tree_note: The Windows-side clone at /home/yashs/SWE-bench_Pro-os has a CRLF-mutated working tree (git status shows ~11009 entries). The committed blobs are LF. All executions in this audit run from a separate LF-normalized mirror of the SAME commit, so upstream content is unmodified.

harbor.note: README documents Modal; local Docker backend is supported and used here because no Modal credentials exist on this machine.

coding_model.credential_source: existing credential already present on this machine (~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json -> deepinfra). Key value never written to any artifact.

agent_harness.locked_protocol: agent phase no-network; verifier never in agent sandbox; authoritative verdict via patch_replay on pristine image

known_environment_deviations: CRLF line endings from Windows checkout broke executable scripts; resolved via LF mirror (audit-side, not a benchmark defect).
Mini-swe-agent installs inside sandbox each run; default 360s agent-setup timeout insufficient (observed AgentSetupTimeoutError), raised via multiplier.
Harbor agent_result token/cost fields report 0 for DeepInfra even on successful runs; cost computed separately from API estimates.

budget_policy.note: Per-task mini-swe-agent cost_limit is 3.0 USD. No Modal/cloud spend; local Docker only. API spend tracked from DeepInfra estimated_cost where exposed.
